title: Night Street
logline: A lone figure waits in the rain, then turns toward a sound.
_comment: Example owner-supplied shot plan. Use with: filmautomator make "..." --plan examples/night_street.json. Any field may be omitted; ShotSpec fills in defaults. Lighting moods: natural, golden_hour, blue_hour, overcast, harsh_noon, moonlight, candlelit, neon, firelight, high_key, low_key, silhouette. Shot sizes: extreme_wide, wide, full, medium_wide, medium, medium_close, close_up, extreme_close_up. Angles: eye_level, low, high, birds_eye, worms_eye, dutch, over_shoulder. Locations are [x, y, z] metres; the camera sits at negative y looking toward the subject.

shots.description: Wide establishing shot: a lone figure stands under a street lamp in heavy rain.

subjects.name: Figure
subjects.action: standing still, shoulders hunched against the rain

quality_criteria: The figure is small in frame but clearly readable as a person.
The frame reads as night: dark overall but not crushed to black.
The figure separates from the background rather than merging with it.

shots.description: Medium shot from a low angle as the figure slowly raises their head.
shots.dramatic_purpose: Shift from place to character; build unease.
quality_criteria: The figure occupies roughly a medium-shot fraction of the frame.
There is strong separation between the lit side and the shadow side.
The frame is dark in mood but the subject is still clearly visible.

shots.description: Tight shot on the figure silhouetted against the lamp glow as they turn.
shots.dramatic_purpose: Punctuate the turn; end on threat.
quality_criteria: The figure reads as a silhouette against a brighter background.
The frame is not so dark that the subject disappears entirely.
The subject fills the frame at close-up scale.
